name: io.github.jasp-nerd/marktplaats-mcp
title: Marktplaats & 2dehands
description: Search Marktplaats & 2dehands (NL/BE classifieds), vet sellers, compare prices, use your account.

environmentVariables.name: MARKTPLAATS_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your marktplaats.nl session Cookie header for the account tools; prefer running 'marktplaats-mcp login' instead.

environmentVariables.name: TWEEDEHANDS_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your 2dehands.be session Cookie header for the account tools.

environmentVariables.name: MARKTPLAATS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable sending messages, bidding and changing favorites.
